Job Description
Read this first: What this role is about
This is a client-lead role. You own client relationships and the commercial growth that comes with them. No disciplinary responsibility. At VI leading isn’t about hierarchy or reporting lines. You set direction and get people pulling towards it, but you don’t manage them on paper. Not an operational project role.

You do not manage or run projects or manage delivery day-to-day. If what energizes you is owning the client and growing the business - rather than carrying disciplinary responsibility or running project operations - you are in the right place!

The Client Relationship. You build close, trusting partnerships with a portfolio of clients and are their primary point of contact.
The Business Value. You do not just process briefings. You actively help client to uncover and solve their real business challenges.
The Order Volume. You turn business challenges of your clients into signed offers. Together with the Client Partner team you are accountable for the agency’s annual order volume.
The Account Rituals. You shape the account team rituals to create the right atmosphere, ambition and dedication to deliver outstanding results that win the clients’ hearts and minds.

A genuine pull towards owning client relationships, commercial growth and energizing the team around the client.
At least 6 yearsin client service, account management or consulting (agency side or in-house).
A completed university degree (engineering, economics or similar) or a comparable qualification.
A strategic mindset and real enthusiasm for digital topics.
Curiosity about people: You connect easily, listen closely and quickly see what matters.
Proficient English and very good written and spoken German is Mandatory.

Über TradeLink
TradeLink baut agentische Plattformen, die europäische Lieferketten auf ein neues Level bringen. Routineaufgaben werden dabei von intelligenten KI-Agenten übernommen, wichtige Entscheidungen und Priorisierungen bleiben in den Teams. Ein Netzwerk, das Unternehmen, Lieferanten und Spediteure verbindet, sorgt für maximale Transparenz, reduziert Zeitverluste und schafft einen sicheren und vertrauensvollen Prozess. Mit TradeLink hat man seine Logistik jederzeit im Griff, statt ihr hinterherzurennen.
Mit KI als Hebel trägst du die volle Verantwortung für strategische Enterprise-Accounts - vom ersten Kontakt bis zur Verlängerung und zum Ausbau der Partnerschaft. Dabei bist du weit mehr als Verkäufer:in: Du berätst Head of Logistics & Co. auf ihrem Weg in die AI-Transformation, zeigst ihnen, was mit agentischer KI in ihrer Lieferkette möglich wird, und bringst sie an die vorderste Front dieser Entwicklung - gemeinsam mit uns.
Aufgaben
Neukunden gewinnen & AI-Transformation gestalten: Du erschließt strategische Enterprise-Accounts - und wirst zum vertrauten Berater ihrer AI-Reise. Du hilfst Enterprise Kunden / Logistik Teams das Potenzial agentischer KI zu erkennen und zu heben, und positionierst sie (und TradeLink) an der Spitze der Supply-Chain-Innovation. Von der ersten Ansprache bis zum Abschluss: Du verkaufst nicht nur ein Produkt, du eröffnest eine neue Art zu arbeiten.
Bestehende Accounts ausbauen: Du entwickelst dein Kundenbuch aktiv weiter - von der klassischen Slotbooking-Nutzung hin zu unserem neuen AI Promise-Produkt und in weitere agentische Workflows hinein.
Probleme verstehen, bevor du Lösungen anbietest: Du hörst zu, fragst nach und verstehst die operativen Herausforderungen deiner Kund:innen wirklich - und übersetzt sie in konkrete AI-Chancen und selbst aufgebaute Pipeline, statt auf eingehende Anfragen zu warten.
Workshops mit Entscheider:innen führen: Du planst und moderierst Workshops mit Enterprise-Entscheider:innen, die Klarheit schaffen und den nächsten kommerziellen Schritt definieren.
Onboarding & Rollout absichern: Gemeinsam mit deinem Product Builder - deinem technischen Tandem-Partner - sorgst du dafür, dass Kunden sauber onboarded werden und technische Anfragen zügig gelöst werden.
KI als Hebel nutzen: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem GTM Engineering zusammen, um KI-gestützte Prozesse in deinem Vertriebsalltag laufend zu verbessern.
Qualifikation
>5 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder Account Management mit Enterprise-Kunden, inklusive eigenständig abgeschlossener Deals mit einem Vertragswert von mindestens €50.000
Praktische Erfahrung darin, KI in den eigenen Sales-Prozess zu integrieren - über reines Prompting hinaus
Erfahrung in Planung, Durchführung und erfolgreichem Abschluss von Workshops mit Enterprise-Entscheider:innen
Die Fähigkeit, schwierige Priorisierungsentscheidungen zu treffen und diese mit klarer eigener Argumentation zu vertreten
Echte Neugier : Du willst Kundenprobleme wirklich verstehen, bevor du über Lösungen sprichst
Freude an Verhandlungen und am Aufbau von Beziehungen - auch unaufgefordert und über den aktuellen Deal hinaus
Erfahrung in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit technischen Teams - Product, Engineering oder Solution Consulting sind von Vorteil
Branchennähe zu Logistik, Supply Chain oder angrenzenden operativen B2B-Umfeldern wären optimal

Impact, Innovation & Ownership: Gestalte unser schnell wachsendes, AI-natives B2B-Startup in der Logistik mit. Wir arbeiten in kleinen, fokussierten Pods, in denen jede:r echte Ergebnisse verantwortet – nicht nur Aufgaben abarbeitet. Nimm Einfluss auf Produkt, Kundenlösungen, Wachstum und Marke. Wir denken groß, handeln schnell und lösen echte Probleme.
AI-Powered, Human-Led: Arbeite an vorderster Front einer Organisation, die AI-nativ aufgebaut ist. Du nutzt AI, um deinen Impact zu vervielfachen – während Urteilsvermögen, Kreativität und Ownership klar menschlich bleiben.
Schnell lernen und wachsen: Kontinuierliches Feedback, 360°-Reviews und ein eigenes Development-Budget, um genau die Skills aufzubauen, die du brauchst. Arbeite eng mit einem erfahrenen Managament Team zusammen, die Richtung vorgeben – statt deinen Alltag im Detail zu steuern.
Leidenschaftliches Team: Werde Teil eines motivierten, unterstützenden Teams, das Klarheit, Ownership und echten Impact schätzt. In unseren Pods arbeitest du in engen, eingespielten Teams – mit echter Zusammenarbeit statt nur geteilten Tools.
Kultur & Zugehörigkeit: Inklusiv, divers und mit Spaß an der Sache – von virtuellen Team-Events bis zu unvergesslichen Offsites schaffen wir überall ein starkes Gemeinschaftsgefühl, inklusive regelmäßigem gemeinsamem Co-Working in Berlin und München.
Am Erfolg beteiligt sein: Über unser VSOP-Programm hast du direkten Anteil am Wachstum des Unternehmens
Auch wenn du dir nicht zu 100 % sicher bist, ob du alle Kriterien erfüllst, möchten wir dich ausdrücklich ermutigen, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Neugier, Begeisterung für digitale Innovation, Lernbereitschaft, Teamgeist und eine echte Growth-Mindset-Mentalität sind für uns am wichtigsten.
TradeLink ist fest davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt eine große Stärke ist, und setzt sich für ein respektvolles, sicheres und offenes Umfeld für alle ein, die bei oder mit uns arbeiten. Um unbewusste Vorurteile im Bewerbungsprozess zu reduzieren, kannst du dein Bewerbungsfoto gern weglassen.

About the Role As an Account Manager on the Uber Eats Alcohol team, you will be responsible for driving demand generation by partnering with alcohol merchants (liquor stores, wine shops, and specialty beverage retailers) on advertising and promotional strategies that increase order volume and customer engagement.

You will serve as a trusted advisor, helping partners maximize their performance on Uber Eats through strategic marketing campaigns, operational optimizations, and data-driven insights tailored to the Alcohol category.

This role requires a blend of sales acumen, analytical skills, and consultative expertise, as you guide merchants on running ads, launching promotions, and enhancing the end-to-end customer experience in a regulated and highly competitive category.

Success is measured by merchant revenue growth, increased campaign adoption, and operational excellence.

What the Candidate Will Need / Bonus Points Merchant Growth & Demand Generation Act as a strategic consultant to alcohol merchants, helping them execute demand generation strategies through Uber Eats' advertising products, promotions, and in-app placements.

Educate partners on category-specific marketing best practices, including how to leverage Uber Ads, discounts, and seasonal/event-based promotions (e.g., holidays, game days, local events). Identify revenue opportunities within the Alcohol vertical, pitch tailored solutions, and support execution of high-impact campaigns.

Monitor campaign performance, optimize spend efficiency, and deliver data-backed recommendations to drive continuous growth.

Operational & Strategic Consulting Advise alcohol merchants on operational best practices to improve customer experience, increase conversion, and minimize cancellations (e.g., inventory accuracy, substitution strategies, prep times).

Conduct assortment and merchandising audits (e.g., product mix, pricing strategy, featured placements) to maximize visibility and basket size. Partner with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product) to influence Alcohol-specific strategy and drive adoption of new features.

Troubleshoot merchant challenges related to fulfillment, delivery compliance, inventory management, and promotional performance. Data-Driven Decision Making Use performance data, category trends, and Uber's analytics tools to identify opportunities and optimize merchant strategies.

Provide regular reporting on key metrics such as advertising ROI, order trends, average basket size, and customer behavior within the Alcohol category. Identify at-risk accounts and proactively implement strategies to improve retention and performance.

Basic Qualifications: 3+ years in account management, consulting, sales, digital advertising, or growth marketing (ideally in tech, e-commerce, or alcohol/beverage industries). Strong sales mindset with the ability to influence decision-makers and drive adoption of marketing solutions.

Ability to analyze data and translate insights into actionable recommendations. Excellent communication skills, including presenting to business owners and stakeholders. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts in a fast-paced environment.

Proficiency in tools like Excel, Looker, Tableau, Salesforce, or similar platforms. Preferred Qualifications: Experience working with alcohol, beverage, or regulated retail categories. Background in digital advertising (Google Ads, Meta, programmatic, or retail media).

Understanding of fulfillment operations, inventory management, and customer experience in on-demand delivery. Familiarity with compliance considerations in the Alcohol space (e.g., ID verification, local regulations). Passion for helping small and mid-sized businesses grow through data-driven strategies.

Job Description
Senior Sales Account Manager | Glasgow, Scotland
Do you have the commercial insight and relationship-building skills to become a trusted partner to some of Scotland’s most important energy organisations?
GE Vernova is looking for an exceptional Senior Sales Account Manager to join our Grid Solutions – Grid Systems Integration team, with Glasgow as the strongly preferred location.
--------------------------------------------------------------------
GE Vernova – The Energy to Change the World
With over 130 years of experience and proven innovation, GE Vernova is leading a new era of energy. We are electrifying the world while working to decarbonise it.
Our name reflects our mission. “GE” carries a legacy of quality and ingenuity. “Ver” signals Earth’s lush ecosystems, while “Nova” represents the new era of lower-carbon energy we are helping to deliver.
Focused on the future, GE Vernova is accelerating the shift to reliable, affordable and sustainable energy. We help customers power economies and deliver electricity that is vital to health, safety and quality of life.
--------------------------------------------------------------------
Electrification
Our Electrification solutions modernise grids, enable renewable integration and strengthen energy systems. From grid technologies and software to power conversion and storage, we help create smarter, more resilient energy networks.
Within Grid Solutions, our Grid Systems Integration business delivers complete high-voltage alternating current and direct current solutions, including engineering, procurement and associated construction services. These range from individual infrastructure upgrades to major, complex programmes worth hundreds of millions of pounds.
--------------------------------------------------------------------

As Senior Sales Account Manager, you will lead and develop our strategic customer relationships across Scotland, positioning GE Vernova as a trusted long-term partner to utilities, developers, industrial organisations and emerging energy customers.
Reporting to the Grid Systems Integration North & South Europe Commercial and Tendering Leader, you will build relationships with senior and executive-level stakeholders, understand customers’ long-term investment priorities and translate their needs into commercially viable opportunities.
You will work closely with Sales, Tendering, Engineering, Commercial Operations, Marketing and wider regional teams to shape customer strategies, develop opportunities and align the organisation around customer requirements.
This is a newly created individual contributor role, providing dedicated commercial leadership for Scotland. You will have the opportunity to shape GE Vernova’s strategic account approach within the market while leading through influence across a complex, international organisation.
--------------------------------------------------------------------
How You Will Make a Difference
Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior and executive-level stakeholders across Scottish utilities and other strategic customers.
Develop and implement account and sales plans that support profitable growth, pipeline development, order intake and long-term market positioning.
Understand customers’ electrification, grid resilience, sustainability and decarbonisation priorities and translate them into opportunities for GE Vernova.
Act as a strategic adviser to customers, connecting their operational and investment needs with relevant technical and commercial solutions.
Map customer organisations, identifying decision-makers, influencers, supporters and potential barriers to successful engagement.
Develop relationship strategies that strengthen GE Vernova’s position and improve customer satisfaction, trust and advocacy over time.
Identify opportunities to grow existing accounts and establish relationships with new customers across utilities, renewable-energy development, industry, data centres and other emerging sectors.
Conduct market and customer analysis to identify future investment programmes, regulatory developments and new business opportunities.
Coordinate internal technical, commercial and operational teams around customer needs throughout the opportunity lifecycle.
Shape competitive customer solutions and support the development of major bids and proposals alongside Sales and Tendering colleagues.
Support commercial and contractual negotiations, helping to secure appropriate commercial terms, governance and risk mitigation.
Identify and support strategic partnerships and alliances that strengthen GE Vernova’s ability to deliver competitive and profitable solutions.
Manage the customer relationship from initial engagement and onboarding through opportunity development, delivery relationships, repeat business and renewals.
Maintain accurate account plans, customer activity, opportunity pipelines and forecasts using Salesforce.
Provide regular insights and recommendations on account performance, customer priorities, market developments and future opportunities.
Represent GE Vernova at customer meetings, industry events, conferences and networking forums across Scotland.
Comply with Grid Solutions Sales and Tendering processes, Delegation of Authority requirements, the GE Vernova Code of Ethics and all applicable environmental, health and safety standards.
--------------------------------------------------------------------
Skills for Success
You will be a confident relationship-builder with strong commercial judgement and the ability to align teams around customer priorities without relying on direct reporting authority.

Significant experience in strategic B2B account management, business development or complex solution sales.
Experience within energy, utilities, grid infrastructure, industrial solutions, cleantech or another relevant technical market.
A strong track record of building and developing relationships with senior and executive-level stakeholders.
The ability to understand complex customer challenges and translate them into clear account strategies and commercial opportunities.
Experience managing long-term, high-value or technically complex sales opportunities.
Strong commercial judgement, with experience supporting negotiations, contractual discussions and risk management.
Excellent stakeholder management, presentation, communication and negotiation skills.
The ability to lead and influence multifunctional teams across a matrix organisation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn customer and market insight into practical action plans.
Experience using Salesforce or a comparable customer relationship management platform.
Fluent written and spoken English.
A bachelor’s degree or equivalent knowledge and experience in engineering, business, commercial management or a related discipline would be valuable. We are, however, most interested in the overall experience, market understanding and professional achievements you would bring to the role.
Experience working with Scottish utilities, transmission or distribution network operators would be a strong advantage. Knowledge of high-voltage transmission solutions, including HVAC, HVDC, substations, grid stability technologies or major EPC infrastructure projects, would also be beneficial.

The Role This is a chance to be a genuine change-maker in US higher education — and one of the most compelling sales opportunities in the market right now. Kinetic is the global market leader in enterprise software for student housing, residence life, conferencing, events, and campus operations. We've been doing this since 1998.

More than 350 institutions across the world run on our platform. We are trusted, proven, and battle-tested at scale. And yet, in the United States, most residence life and housing teams have never heard of us. That's the opportunity.

There are only two vendors in the world capable of handling the deep, complex operational demands of large-scale student housing at the enterprise level. We are one of them. Until recently, US institutions haven't had a genuine choice.

Many are running on legacy systems they've outgrown — systems that frustrate their teams and limit what they can deliver for students. Now there's a credible alternative, with a 27-year track record of transforming operations at institutions just like theirs. This role is about closing.

It takes a seasoned new logo hunter — someone who knows how to build conviction in an uninformed audience, navigate complex institutional sales cycles, and drive decisions in an environment where inertia is the enemy.

You won't just be opening doors; you'll be walking through them, winning over stakeholders at every level, and bringing home contracts that mark the beginning of decades-long partnerships. Once you close, you hand over to a dedicated customer delivery and success team who take ownership of the relationship — so you can stay focused on hunting.

But make no mistake: the partnerships you create are permanent. Kinetic is part of Volaris Group and Constellation Software, a buy-and-hold acquirer — we will never be sold. The institutions that choose us are choosing a partner that will be there for the long haul, investing in their success year after year.

What you win, we keep — and we build on — forever. If you're a top-tier new logo closer who wants to do meaningful work — not just hit a number — this role was built for you. Who We Are Kinetic is part of Volaris Group, a division of Constellation Software Inc. — one of the largest software companies in the world.

Constellation is a buy-and-hold acquirer. We are never sold. We grow, we invest, and we build for the long term alongside other global market leaders in education technology and beyond. You are a hunter by nature — you create momentum where none exists

Why Kinetic We are a high-performance business — and we mean that in the truest sense. Not pressure for its own sake, but a thriving environment where everyone is pushing forward together, challenging each other, and delivering for colleagues and customers alike. We span multiple countries. We don't do silos.

We operate on a simple belief: high challenge and high support go hand in hand. We will push you outside your comfort zone — regularly. We expect you to make mistakes. We want you to. Because in this business, mistakes mean you're moving, learning, and growing — and when our people grow, the business grows. We believe in accountability, not blame.

There are no losers on a winning team, and no winners on a losing team. Sales is the lifeblood of what we do. When we're winning new customers, everyone feels it — the energy, the momentum, the sense that something real is being built. This role is at the spearhead of that.

Kinetic has been in the US market since 2006, and since bringing our student housing software stateside two years ago, the business has been in hyper growth — and the person in this seat is central to keeping that momentum going. We have a people-first mindset — with our team and with our customers.

We all have two ears and one mouth, and we try to use them in that proportion. We don't tell customers how to do their jobs. We ask, we listen, and we work to understand what's holding them back — and then we help remove their barriers. That's the culture we bring to every relationship, internal and external. We also believe in having fun.

Genuinely. A thriving business is an enjoyable one, and we work hard to make sure this is a place people love to be. Our values are leadership, community, student success, and the KxFactor. An authenticity. An energy. A way of showing up that makes people want to work alongside you and stay in your orbit. You can't manufacture it. You'll know if you have it — and so will we. Benefits & Perks Why You’ll Love Working at Kinetic

Success in this role requires both domain expertise and an established network across the medical device, life science, and pharmaceutical landscape. We believe clarity drives performance. Here's what the first 90 days look like in this role:

60 days - Running their own discovery calls independently; at least 2–3 qualified opportunities in HubSpot with clear next steps; has shadowed deal reviews and can articulate the DataPRO RWE & RPRO commercial model, pricing structure, and common objections without support; applying lessons from prior segment deals to sharpen their pitch and prioritize the right accounts.
90 days - First deal in active negotiation or closed; owns a named account list with documented outreach and engagement history; has delivered at least one data feasibility or DataPRO RWE, or RPRO pitch to a prospective buyer with minimal internal support; trusted partner to clinical, product, and data teammates on deal design and execution.

Company Description
Swiftly is on a mission to help cities move more efficiently. We are the leading transit data platform for agencies to share real-time passenger information, manage day-to-day operations, and improve service performance.

Today, over 200 transit agencies in 12 countries – including LA Metro, MARTA, SEPTA, and MBTA – rely on Swiftly to improve on-time performance by up to 40% and increase passenger information accuracy by up to 50%. The result is better service reliability, increased ridership, and more efficient transit operations.
Even though Swiftly's HQ office is located in San Francisco, CA, we are open to candidates in most locations across the U.S. as well as Ontario and British Columbia, Canada. At this time we are unable to provide Visa sponsorship.

Swiftly is seeking an exceptional Sales Manager, SMB to lead and develop our SMB Account Executive team. This is a management role focused on building, coaching, and developing a high-performing sales team — ideal for a sales leader who thrives on developing reps, driving accountability, and winning in the public-sector transit market.

We're in a period of growth and are building the go-to-market team that will define our next chapter. If you're passionate about developing talent, winning in a high-velocity SMB sales environment, and making public transit better for millions of riders, we want to talk to you.
As Sales Manager, SMB, you will lead a team of 5 SMB Account Executives driving new logo acquisition with small and mid-size transit agencies across North America.

Your AEs build and manage territory plans, prospect a significant share of their own pipeline, run discovery calls and platform demos, build ROI-driven business cases, and guide government agencies through procurement to close — typically on 3 to 8 month sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and government procurement processes.

You'll be responsible for hiring, onboarding, coaching, and developing these reps while setting the coaching rhythm, building pipeline strategy, and ensuring the team executes with discipline using the SPICED methodology. You'll also partner with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to align on strategy and improve the buyer experience.
Sales at Swiftly
Our Sales team is responsible for introducing Swiftly's platform to transit agencies and helping them understand how our real-time data, historical insights, and operational analytics can transform their service.

We sell to government agencies with consultative sales cycles that require thorough discovery, strong relationships, and a genuine passion for improving public transit. Every deal matters — not just for revenue, but because each new agency means better service for the riders who depend on it.
To ensure we are making an impact throughout the sales process, we use a value-driven sales methodology. Our GTM teams are trained on the SPICED methodology, which serves as a blueprint for achieving sales targets, and we expect our sales managers to coach and reinforce it across their teams.

Team Leadership and Coaching
Recruit, onboard, and develop a high-performing team of SMB Account Executives.
Establish and maintain a coaching rhythm: regular 1:1s, call reviews, deal reviews, and skills development sessions.
Set clear performance expectations and hold the team accountable to activity metrics, pipeline targets, and quota attainment.
Foster a culture of learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement across the team.
Pipeline and Revenue
Own the team's pipeline generation strategy, ensuring AEs prospect approximately 50 to 60% of their own pipeline through outbound calling, email campaigns, and tools such as LinkedIn.
Drive disciplined territory planning and account prioritization across the SMB segment.
Support AEs in navigating public-sector deals with typical 3 to 8 month sales cycles, multiple stakeholders, and government procurement processes.
Actively join AEs on discovery calls, demos, and business case development when needed.
Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline reporting in Salesforce; provide weekly forecast updates to leadership using Swiftly's forecast methodology.
Achieve and exceed team revenue goals.
Process and Strategy
Champion and enforce the SPICED sales methodology across the team.
Coach the team on identifying and mitigating deal risk, partnering with leadership, internal partners, and executives as needed.
Oversee Swiftly's responses to public solicitations within your team's territories, with the support of our internal procurement team.
Represent Swiftly at industry conferences (APTA, TransITech, state transit associations) and coach your team on event strategy.
Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to refine messaging, share market feedback, and improve the buyer experience.
Lead the adoption of AI-assisted and modern sales workflows that improve prospecting efficiency and sales effectiveness.

7+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with at least 3 years in a frontline sales management role.
Experience scaling an SMB sales team is a strong plus.
Proven track record of leading teams to meet or exceed quota in a new-logo sales environment.
Strong coaching instincts — you develop reps, not just manage them.
Experience with consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and procurement processes.
Comfortable with government or public-sector sales; transit industry experience is a plus but not required.
Proficient with Salesforce, Gong Engage, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and modern sales tools.
Excellent communication skills — you can lead a team meeting, run a deal review, and present to executives with equal confidence.
Willingness to travel for conferences, team events, and strategic customer meetings.

* Technische und/oder kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung auf Stufe FH, HF oder TS

This is a Remote — European Union (multi-country), with travel across Europe and the Middle EastEverything happens somewhere — which is why spatial analytics is fundamental to companies trying to understand the “where” and the “why” of their business.

CARTO is the leading cloud-native location intelligence platform, trusted by data scientists, data analysts and developers from multiple National, State, and Local levels around the world to provide geospatial insights for use cases such as site selection, geomarketing, route optimization, network planning and much more.

With an exceptionally diverse team spread across the US and Europe, CARTO is changing the way companies analyze location data — making it simple to do this straight out of modern, cloud data warehouses. Redefining its category, the company has grown rapidly in recent years providing a compelling alternative to legacy GIS software.
CARTO is cloud-native by design: the platform connects directly to the data warehouses enterprises already run — Google BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, Databricks — so geospatial analysis happens where the customer’s data already lives , with no data movement.

And where sovereignty requires it, CARTO runs on open formats and open standards deployed on sovereign or on-premise environments. In a European market where digital sovereignty has moved from the IT backroom to the boardroom, that architecture is a decisive commercial advantage.
The opportunity European organizations are under intensifying pressure to keep sensitive data under EU jurisdictional control.

The EU Data Act, the AI Act, DORA and NIS2, the European Commission’s Cloud Sovereignty Framework, and national sovereignty initiatives have turned sovereignty into a procurement requirement — especially across government, defense, financial services, utilities, and critical infrastructure.

At the same time, a generation of legacy GIS is reaching end of life and being rebuilt for an AI-native world.
CARTO ’s architecture speaks directly to both shifts. Because analysis runs inside the customer’s own environment, on open formats and portable compute, CARTO helps customers stay AI-ready, avoid vendor lock-in, and keep control of their data. This role exists to turn that positioning into pipeline and revenue across Europe.
The role We are hiring an EU-based Business Development Manager to develop the market for CARTO ’s sovereignty proposition at the European level.

In this hunting, market-development role, you will open net-new logos, build and activate partner-led motions with cloud and sovereign-ecosystem players, and develop the public-sector and regulated-industry market where sovereignty requirements are most stringent — government, defense, national mapping and space agencies.

You will work across multiple EU countries rather than a single territory, with opportunities extending into the Middle East as the business grows. This is an individual-contributor role measured on qualified pipeline and closed ARR while you build the motion, ramping to a carried new-business quota as the segment matures.

You will report to the CRO organization and partner closely with Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Partnerships, and Legal/InfoSec.
You will
Develop the European sovereignty market for CARTO — identify, prioritize, and open net-new public-sector accounts across multiple EU countries where data sovereignty is a live buying driver.
Own the full sales cycle end to end: outbound prospecting, discovery, qualification, mission impact, RFP response — then drive deals through to close with the support of the broader team.
Build and activate partner-led pipeline with cloud data platforms (Google Cloud, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks) and the European sovereign-cloud ecosystem — including GAIA-X–aligned providers, sovereign cloud operators, and recognized boutique and large system integrators in the region — to co-sell into sovereignty-driven opportunities.
Develop the sovereign public sector market (national and state government, defense and civilian, national mapping and space agencies), navigating procurement, tenders, and framework agreements.
Position CARTO ’s architecture as a sovereignty advantage and translate EU regulation (EU Data Act, AI Act, DORA, NIS2, the Cloud Sovereignty Framework / SEAL levels) into concrete mission impact.
Treat procurement, RFPs, security questionnaires, and infosec reviews as routine parts of the motion — anticipate them, engage Legal/InfoSec early, and keep deals moving through them.
Map prospect organizations to build multi-threaded relationships with technical, commercial, and compliance decision-makers, up to and including the board-level and government sponsors who now own sovereignty decisions.
Build and maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene and forecasting in Salesforce; use Gong and the wider revenue stack to inspect and advance deals.
Feed the field back into the business — share sovereignty signals, competitive intelligence, and packaging feedback with Product, Marketing, and Partnerships to sharpen the EU go-to-market.
Travel across Europe (and occasionally the Middle East) for customer, partner, and industry events (approximately 40–50%).
You offer
We are deliberately open on background. Geospatial experience is an advantage, not a requirement — strong candidates may come from sovereign cloud, enterprise data/analytics, or public-sector and defense technology sales.
5+ year track record of success selling or developing new business for SaaS / data / analytics products in a quota-carrying role, preferably in the geospatial, data science, BI, cloud, or analytics space.
Demonstrable experience developing net-new markets or segments — you are a hunter who is comfortable creating pipeline from a standing start, not inheriting a book of business.
Working knowledge of the European digital sovereignty landscape — the EU Data Act, AI Act, DORA, NIS2, GDPR, the US CLOUD Act / FISA concerns that drive it, GAIA-X, and the EU Cloud Sovereignty Framework / SEAL assurance levels.
Public-sector go-to-market experience — familiarity with tenders, framework agreements, and procurement cycles is a strong plus.
Experience selling with and through strategic partners — cloud platforms and/or European sovereign-cloud providers, resellers, and system integrators.
Comfort with procurement-heavy sales: RFPs, security questionnaires, and infosec reviews are routine, not exceptions, and you know how to run them in parallel with the commercial motion.
A MEDDICC practitioner — formally trained and able to apply the methodology to qualify and secure complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
Understanding of the geospatial, GIS, analytics, and cloud marketspace, able to think strategically about competition, impact, and CARTO ’s role in the market.
Multi-country EU selling experience; fluent English plus at least one other relevant language (German, French, or another EU language) strongly preferred.
Proficient in the modern revenue stack: Salesforce, Gong, Apollo, LinkedIn, and others. Familiarity with consumption-based commercial models is a plus.

s.h: Your Mission This is a company built for growth.
s.t:
When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins.

We build high-performing consumer products in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming, leading one of its largest innovations, a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences.
As a Senior Business Development Manager (f/m/x), you’ll drive high-impact initiatives directly for the CRO and COO. Moving fluidly between strategic growth and operational excellence, you will open new advertiser relationships, revive paused accounts, and launch entirely new verticals from scratch. There is no fixed playbook here: you’ll write it as you go balancing cold outreach and commercial negotiations with RevOps projects designed to automate and scale our Revenue team.
At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.
If you value impact, data-led decisions, and ownership, let's talk.
In this role you will: Value-creation strategy: Develop a structured value creation plan to prioritize high impact growth levers for partners, while owning the full sales pipeline from prospecting and negotiating commercials to bringing campaigns live and scaling them.
Reactivation & Account Optimization: Systematically diagnose why paused or underperforming accounts are missing their full potential. You’ll build and execute tailored commercial and technical recovery plans collaborating with internal teams and clients to close performance gaps and bring advertisers back to scale.
New Vertical Launches: Take new verticals from idea to first revenue, mapping demand, understanding geo, payment and legal framework, and landing the first reference partners.
RevOps & Enablement: Run "special" projects that make the commercial org faster, from automating manual workflows to codifying best practices and playbooks for the Account Management team.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Work closely with Product, Marketing, Legal & Compliance, Finance and Account Management to unblock deals, shape integrations and hand over accounts cleanly once they're live.
Data-Driven Decision Making: Build the business case yourself, model deal economics i.e. CPI, ROAS, revenue share, LTV and use performance data to structure partnerships that work for the partner and for exmox.
Product Voice & Advocacy: Translate what you hear in the market into prioritized, revenue-driving requirements for the roadmap.
What You Bring Relevant Experience: 5-7 years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or B2B sales, with a proven history of personally initiating and closing high-impact deals.
"Swiss Army Knife" Profile: You're a builder and a generalist. You're as comfortable opening a new market as you are documenting a process, and you don't wait for someone to define the scope for you.
Commercial Hunter Mentality: A "sales-driven" personality obsessed with moving the needle; you are constantly asking "how can we double these numbers?" to drive exponential growth.
Data-Driven Mindset: Highly analytical, comfortable in spreadsheets and BI tools, able to turn raw performance data into a commercial argument and a clear next step.
Process & Automation Instinct: You notice repetitive work and remove it. Hands-on experience with CRM, no-code automation or AI tooling to scale your own output and the team's is a strong plus.
Communication Skills: Full professional fluency in English with the interpersonal "spine" to challenge partners' assumptions and stand your ground during tough negotiations.
Ambitious & Goal-Oriented: A self-starter with high "eagerness" who doesn't just meet targets but proactively seeks ways to exceed them.
Nice to have: Management consulting background (e.g., Bain, BCG, McKinsey) combined with business development for a tech scale up.
Nice to have: Sales experience within adtech, gaming, rewarded user acquisition industry.
How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. “Not my job” isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

Die Firma Rohrbogen AG ist ein international tätiges Familienunternehmen mit Standorten in der Schweiz und in Polen. Die hochwertigen Produkte vertreibt sie weltweit mit einem europäischen Fokus. Dabei schätzen Kunden das umfangreiche Know\-how und die Flexibilität bei der Produktion von Rohrbogen und Formteilen aus Edelstahl für die Bereiche Industrie, Chemie, Pharmazie, Lebensmittel sowie Fahrzeug\- und Apparatebau.
Leiter/in Technischer Verkauf (m/w/d \| 80\-100%)
=================================================
Als Leiter/In technischer Verkauf verbindest du deine Begeisterung für den Vertrieb mit technischem Know\-How. Deine Hauptaufgabe besteht darin, die Verkaufsstrategie für den technischen Verkauf weiterzuentwickeln und mit uns gemeinsam die Zukunft zu gestalten. Dabei stehen dir alle Möglichkeiten offen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und deine Fähigkeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld weiterzuentwickeln.
### Deine Aufgaben
* Technische neue Produkte: Du bearbeitest neue Anfragen, klärst Anforderungen und beurteilst gemeinsam mit unserem technischen Team die technische Machbarkeit und erarbeitest die kommerziellen Angebote bis zur Auftragsvergabe.
* Projektleitung: Du führst und motivierst das technische Projektteam bei neuen Kundenprojekten vom ersten Entwurf über Muster und Erstmuster bis zur erfolgreichen Serienauslieferung. Bei technischen oder terminlichen Herausforderungen koordinierst du die notwendigen Abklärungen, fasst konsequent nach und begleitest Lösungen bis zum Abschluss.
* Schnittstellenkoordination: Du arbeitest eng mit Technik, Produktion, Einkauf und unseren Produktionsstandorten zusammen und stellst einen reibungslosen Informationsfluss sicher.
* Kundenbetreuung: Du bist technische Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden, baust bestehende Beziehungen weiter aus und unterstützt bei der Entwicklung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.
* Strategische Verkaufsplanung: Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Verkaufsstrategien zur Steigerung des Umsatzes und Marktanteils.
* Budget\- und Zielverantwortung: Erstellung und Kontrolle von Verkaufsbudgets, Sicherstellung der Erreichung von Umsatz\- und Profitzielen.
### Dein Profil
* Technische Grundausbildung von Vorteil, idealerweise ergänzt durch eine Weiterbildung auf Stufe HF/FH oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung im technischen Verkauf
* Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis und Freude daran, technische Lösungen gemeinsam mit Kunden und internen Fachstellen zu entwickeln
* Interesse am Verkauf und daran, dich im technischen Vertrieb weiterzuentwickeln
* Freude an Kundenkontakt, Projektarbeit und bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit
* Selbständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
* Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, technische Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln
* Führungserfahrung ist nicht erforderlich, wichtiger sind für uns dein Potenzial, deine Motivation und deine Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen
### Das bieten wir dir
Bei uns erwartet dich keine klassische Verkaufsstelle, bei der du vom ersten Tag an nur Umsatzzahlen hinterherläufst. Stattdessen erhältst du die Möglichkeit, unsere Produkte, Prozesse und Kunden von Grund auf kennenzulernen und dich Schritt für Schritt in eine verantwor\-tungsvolle Funktion im technischen Verkauf zu entwickeln.
Wir bieten dir viel Gestaltungsspielraum, kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, deine technischen Kenntnisse mit Verkauf, Projektmanagement und später auch Führungsverantwortung zu verbinden.

In a nutshell, we’re all about making great wine better, for everyone. We partner directly with the world’s best independent winemakers to bring our members better-quality wine for a better price. No thirsty middlemen as far as the eye can see.
It’s a different way of doing things, sure. But it works. We’re one of the US’ favorite wine clubs, shipping over 1 million (!) cases a year to curious wine lovers. And with an ambitious road ahead, we’ve got no plans on plugging the cork on growth.
Our global team (we have offices in the UK and Australia, too) is entrepreneurial by nature, obsessive about customer experience and driven by performance. All things that make Naked a great place to grow both personally and professionally. And yes, we like wine. A lot – we even have a wine fridge in the office.

It takes a village to run Naked. That’s why we’re always on the lookout for eager talent to join the bunch. And now, our B2B team is looking for a new Commercial Wine Sales Manager to be part of the fun.
So if you’re excited to help us connect more wine lovers with talented winemakers, there’s a Naked welcome pack with your name on it.
Together, we’ll take Naked Wines to the next level – and share our not-so-well-kept secret with the world.
Location & flexible working: Remote, but must reside in the state of California for employer tax purposes.

We are Naked Together – our business is built on an ecosystem where we must all work together. Together we can go further than we can alone.

Leading a team of Sales & Partnerships Managers, you will be responsible for accelerating revenue growth, expanding strategic partnerships, and scaling Uber Health & Transit across healthcare organisations, local authorities, transport providers, insurers, and other regulated sectors.

Partner closely with the Bids & Proposals team to maximise win rates and deliver high-quality commercial responses.

Establish scalable sales processes, account segmentation, territory planning, and sales playbooks that improve productivity, pipeline generation, and forecasting accuracy.
Drive operational excellence through disciplined pipeline management, accurate forecasting, and effective use of Salesforce and other sales productivity tools.
Work cross-functionally with Operations, Product, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, and Engineering to remove commercial barriers, accelerate deal progression, and support successful customer launches.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer obsession across the team.

2-3+ years of people management experience leading high-performing sales or business development teams.
Experience leading consultative sales teams managing complex enterprise and public sector sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
Strong understanding of formal procurement, competitive tendering, and bid-led sales environments.
Demonstrated success recruiting, coaching, and developing high-performing commercial teams.
Experience building pipeline through strategic prospecting, account planning, and customer engagement.
Excellent commercial acumen with the ability to use data to drive decision-making, optimise performance, and improve sales processes.
Outstanding communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with confidence engaging C-level executives and senior public sector leaders.

Die Position im RampenLICHT
---------------------------
Als Vertriebsprofi für Lichtlösungen übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle an der Schnittstelle von Kunde, Planung und Projektabwicklung. Du entwickelst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen weiter, gewinnst neue Projekte und begleitest deine Lösungen mit technischem Know\-how und Verkaufsstärke bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Dabei verbindest du Marktverständnis und Eigeninitiative mit einem sicheren Gespür für die Anforderungen deiner Kunden und schaffst so nachhaltigen Mehrwert für beide Seiten.
Aufgaben in diesem Job
----------------------
* **Kunden entwickeln:** Du betreust und entwickelst dein Kundenportfolio gezielt weiter – von Elektroinstallateuren bis zu Architekten, Bauherren und Generalunternehmern.
* **Projekte gewinnen:** Du akquirierst neue Beleuchtungsprojekte und begleitest Ausschreibungen bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.
* **Lösungen verkaufen:** Du berätst Kunden zu Lichtlösungen und Produktneuheiten und unterstützt sie bei der Planung vor Ort.
* **Verantwortung übernehmen:** Du steuerst deine Projekte eigenständig und behältst Umsatz, Deckungsbeitrag und Kalkulation im Blick.
* **Zusammenarbeit koordinieren:** Du sorgst für einen reibungslosen Austausch mit Sachbearbeitung, Lichtplanung, Disposition und Buchhaltung.
* **Markt mitgestalten:** Du beobachtest Markt und Wettbewerb und nutzt Messen, Veranstaltungen und Kundenschulungen gezielt für die Geschäftsentwicklung.
Kenntnisse \& Erfahrung
-----------------------
* **Technisches Fundament:** Du hast eine Ausbildung im Elektrobereich oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation; alternativ eine kaufmännische Weiterbildung mit mehrjähriger Verkaufserfahrung.
* **Lichtkompetenz:** Du kennst Leuchten sowie Lichtmanagement\- und Notlichtsysteme und bringst Grundkenntnisse in IT und Netzwerktechnik mit.
* **Vertriebserfahrung:** Du hast Freude am Verkauf, bist kundenorientiert und trittst souverän und durchsetzungsstark auf.
* **Eigenverantwortung**: Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und behältst auch bei hoher Auslastung den Überblick.
* **Ergebnisorientierung:** Du denkst unternehmerisch, erkennst Chancen und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Ergebnisse.
* **Kommunikationsstärke:** Du kommunizierst stilsicher auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch.
Was wir bieten
--------------
* **Karriere mit Perspektive:** Entfalte dein Potenzial mit vielfältigen Entwicklungs\- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten in einem internationalen Umfeld.
* **Gezielte Förderung:** Wir investieren in deine Zukunft – mit finanzieller und zeitlicher Unterstützung für interne und externe Weiterbildungen.
* **Flexibles Arbeiten:** Nutze moderne digitale Tools und genieße die Freiheit von Remote\-Work (2 Tage/Woche) sowie flexible Arbeitszeiten.
* **Attraktive Benefits:** Profitiere von einer überdurchschnittlichen Pensionskasse und großzügigen Sonderregelungen.
* **Teamspirit:** Erlebe ein starkes Miteinander durch regelmäßige Firmenevents und Teambuilding\-Aktivitäten.
